text:
morgan: FYI starting coordinated release in 22m — API=v2.7.0, runtime=kernel-qt1.8, console=5.11.0, router=header-proxy-v3. Plan: warmup 3% (2m) -> canary 12% (4m) -> PAUSE20 manual gate -> ramp 60% -> 100%. Add a 4m observation after 60% for p99 tail. Any blockers?

alex: +1. Request explicit KV eviction watch during PAUSE20. Last kernel bump caused a short eviction spike. Suggest pause timer 10m at 20% with manual resume.

emily: console will flip asset flag at +8m, lowering CDN TTL to 30s for 15m. Release notes updated. Console rollback requires CDN purge (~3-6m). :memo:

sasha: security note — CSP header change in this console patch. Router must passthrough the new header; I'll validate during the 12% canary. If header drops >0.2% revert router immediately.

jay: observability ready. Health probes: /health, /v1/chat/ping, /v1/embeddings/ping. Auto-rollback triggers: p95 > 150ms OR error_rate > 0.7% sustained 90s -> initiate rollback. I'll post canary metrics after each stage.

deploy-bot: deploy request queued by morgan: "cutover-1748301234". Scheduled start in 22m. Pins applied: API=2.7.0, Runtime=kernel-qt1.8. PAUSE_AT_20 configured with manual gate. Rollback window: 60m post-cutover. To cancel: `/deploy cancel cutover-1748301234`. Resume: `/deploy resume cutover-1748301234`. Rollback command: `/deploy rollback cutover-1748301234`. Streaming status here.

morgan: Confirm rollback ordering and dynamic rules: default order runtime -> api -> router -> console. Exception rules: if client-visible 4xx/5xx spike -> api-first; if kernel-side tokenization latency or kernel errors -> runtime-first; if CSP/header loss -> router-first. Rollback targets: runtime->kernel-qt1.7, api->v2.6.x, router->revert-header-proxy-v2, console->5.10.x.

alex: agree. Make dynamic rule explicit: check error type and X-Runtime-Kernel header in smoke before deciding order.

emily: console notes — edge invalidation will be done immediately on console rollback; expect ~3-6m to propagate. Tagging ops-oncall for edge tasks.

sasha: i'll run header passthrough checks during the 12% canary. If CSP violations or header drop >0.2% for 3m, i'll request router-first rollback.

jay: T-5 smoke volunteer — i'll run: `curl -sS -H "x-smoke: true" -I https://api.redwood.test/health | grep -i X-Runtime-Kernel` and `curl -sS https://api.redwood.test/health | jq -r '.status'`. Preflight load: `hey -z 12s -q 50 -c 10 https://api.redwood.test/chat` to check tail. I'll post a one-line summary at T-5.

morgan: Who will approve PAUSE20 resume? alex + sasha?

alex: I'll approve if p95 < 130ms and KV eviction stable.

sasha: I'll approve if header passthrough intact and CSP violations <0.05%.

emily: noted. I'll be standing by for CDN purge ops if console rollback needed.

deploy-bot: Note: PAUSE_AT_20 has timeout 10m. If gate expires without resume, deploy will auto-abort. Auto-abort also on attached rollback triggers. Streaming logs to this thread during each stage.

jmorgan (typo): (ignore)

morgan: thanks all. Kicking off at scheduled time and will post each stage here. Ping this thread to request immediate rollback or emergency fixes. :rocket:
